message.content: {"action":"sell_credit","units":3,"reason":"Sell on credit: 1.25x revenue avoids the round-3 cash devaluation, maximizing final payout."}
message.reasoning_content: Round 3, prices start at 12. Sell 3 units for cash now (round boundary 3+ devalues cash to 62%). Actually cash devaluation applies at rounds 2+ borders. Selling now gives cash which devalues at end of round 3 (floor(cash/100)*62). Better sell_credit: revenue*1.25 paid at next round border, added to cash then... promissory adds to cash at boundary then zeroed — does devaluation apply? "at round borders 2+ cash=floor(cash/100)*62, promissory is added to cash and zeroed" — likely promissory added after devaluation, avoiding it, plus 1.25x. So sell_credit better: 3*12*1.25=45 vs 36*0.62=22.3.
